proof_summary: A modular computation shows that \(28341^{28341}\equiv1\pmod{283411^2}\), while checking all proper divisors of \(28341\) shows that \(28341\) has exact multiplicative order \(28341\) modulo the prime \(283411\). In the factorization \(28341^{28341}-1=\prod_{d\mid28341}\Phi_d(28341)\), this order computation excludes \(283411\) from every proper-divisor factor, so coprimality forces the full square factor into the top cyclotomic factor.
